evidence.name: The Murder Weapon
evidence.description: A unique switchblade found at the scene. The defendant claims he lost a similar one.

evidence.name: The Woman Across the Street
evidence.description: Testified she saw the boy stab his father through the windows of a passing elevated train.

evidence.name: The Old Man Below
evidence.description: Testified he heard the boy shout 'I'm gonna kill you!' followed by a body hitting the floor. He saw the boy running down the stairs.
